mapper.sql: select o.id, o.price, o.product_amount, o.business_type, o.create_time, o.expected_delivery_time, o.gap, o.category_id, c.category_name, p.public_address as pick_up_address, r.public_address as recive_address, o.user_id, sender.username as username, o.note, o.door_access from tb_orders o left join tb_user sender on sender.id = o.user_id join tb_category c on c.id = o.category_id join tb_order_address_snapshot p on p.order_id = o.id and p.role = 'PICKUP' join tb_order_address_snapshot r on r.order_id = o.id and r.role = 'RECEIVE' where o.deleted = 0 and o.status = 0
mapper.select: order by o.create_time desc limit 100

AND o.category_id = #{query.categoryId} AND LOCATE(BINARY #{label}, BINARY p.public_address) > 0 AND LOCATE(BINARY #{label}, BINARY r.public_address) > 0
AND (BINARY LOWER(COALESCE(o.note,'')) LIKE BINARY CONCAT('%',#{query.literalKeyword},'%') ESCAPE '!' OR BINARY LOWER(COALESCE(c.category_name,'')) LIKE BINARY CONCAT('%',#{query.literalKeyword},'%') ESCAPE '!' OR BINARY LOWER(COALESCE(p.public_address,'')) LIKE BINARY CONCAT('%',#{query.literalKeyword},'%') ESCAPE '!' OR BINARY LOWER(COALESCE(r.public_address,'')) LIKE BINARY CONCAT('%',#{query.literalKeyword},'%') ESCAPE '!')
ORDER BY
COALESCE(o.price,0) desc, COALESCE(o.price,0) asc,
o.create_time desc, o.id desc LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}
AND o.id = #{id}

-- 这里查找出来的字段为OrderShowVO字段，别名为了能够匹配上 SELECT orders.id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, -- 取件地址，字符串，类似：浙大城市学院 南校区 寝室楼 弘毅楼 寝室楼下 address_recive.address AS recive_address, -- 收件地址，字符串，类似：浙大城市学院 南校区 寝室楼 弘毅楼 寝室楼下 orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.service_fee_rate, orders.service_fee, orders.pay_amount, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time , orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, orders.deleted FROM tb_orders AS orders, -- 这是订单表 主表 tb_category AS category,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.deleted = 0 AND orders.status = 0 AND orders.category_id = category.id AND orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id
ORDER BY orders.price desc
ORDER BY orders.price
LIMIT 20

SELECT orders.id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.service_fee_rate, orders.service_fee, orders.pay_amount, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, orders.deleted FROM tb_orders AS orders, tb_category AS category,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.deleted = 0 AND (orders.publisher_hidden = 0 OR orders.status NOT IN (-3, 4, 6)) AND orders.category_id = category.id AND orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id AND orders.user_id = #{id}
mapper.select: ORDER BY orders.create_time desc, orders.id desc LIMIT 20

SELECT orders.id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.service_fee_rate, orders.service_fee, orders.pay_amount, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, orders.deleted FROM tb_orders AS orders, tb_category AS category,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.deleted = 0 AND orders.status = 0 AND orders.category_id = category.id AND orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id
ORDER BY orders.create_time desc
ORDER BY orders.create_time
LIMIT 20

SELECT orders.id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.service_fee_rate, orders.service_fee, orders.pay_amount, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, orders.deleted, user.realname, user.username AS sender_nickname -- user.phone FROM tb_orders AS orders, tb_category AS category, tb_user as user, (SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.deleted = 0 AND -- orders.status = 0 AND orders.category_id = category.id AND orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id AND orders.user_id = user.id AND orders.id = #{id}
-- ORDER BY orders.create_time

select * from tb_orders where status = #{status} and cancel_time < #{cancelTime}

order by orders.create_time desc LIMIT 20

select status from tb_orders where deleted = 0 AND order_number = #{orderNumber}

mapper.insert: insert into tb_orders(id, pick_up_address, recive_address, order_number, price, product_amount, business_type, service_fee_rate, service_fee, pay_amount, expected_delivery_time, delivery_time, cancel_time, cancel_reson, exceed_time, gap, create_time, door_access, user_id, username, phone, status, note, category_id, deleted) values( null, #{pickUpAddress}, #{reciveAddress}, #{orderNumber}, #{price}, #{productAmount}, #{businessType}, #{serviceFeeRate}, #{serviceFee}, #{payAmount}, #{expectedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelReson}, #{exceedTime}, #{gap}, #{createTime}, #{doorAccess}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{note}, #{categoryId}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET publisher_hidden = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} AND status IN (-3, 4, 6) AND deleted = 0 AND publisher_hidden = 0 AND (status != 4 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_payment_log p WHERE p.order_number = tb_orders.order_number )) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_refund_info r WHERE r.order_number = tb_orders.order_number AND (r.refund_status IS NULL OR r.refund_status != 'SUCCESS') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wx_transfer_log t WHERE t.order_number = tb_orders.order_number AND (t.state IS NULL OR t.state != 'SUCCESS') ) AND (status != -3 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_refund_info r WHERE r.order_number = tb_orders.order_number AND r.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.total_fee > 0 AND r.refund = r.total_fee AND r.total_fee = tb_orders.pay_amount * 100 )) AND (status != 6 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wx_transfer_log t WHERE t.order_number = tb_orders.order_number AND t.state = 'SUCCESS' AND t.transfer_amount > 0 ))
update tb_orders set note = #{note} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0 and deleted = 0
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN tb_refund_info ri ON ri.id = ( SELECT MAX(r.id) FROM tb_refund_info r WHERE r.order_number = o.order_number AND r.total_fee > 0 AND r.refund > 0 )

sql.if: AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{keyword}), LOWER(COALESCE(o.order_number, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{keyword}), LOWER(COALESCE(o.username, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, COALESCE(o.phone, '')) > 0)

SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.status, c.category_name, o.price, o.product_amount, o.business_type, (o.product_amount + o.price) AS runner_receivable, o.service_fee_rate, o.service_fee, o.pay_amount, o.username, o.phone, o.note, o.door_access, o.gap, o.exceed_time, o.create_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_reson AS cancel_reason, ap.address AS pick_up_address, ar.address AS recive_address, tk.id AS take_order_id, tk.user_id AS taker_user_id, tk_user.realname AS taker_realname, tk_user.phone AS taker_phone, tk.create_time AS taker_take_time, tk.delivery_time AS taker_delivery_time, pl.transaction_id AS payment_transaction_id, pl.trade_state AS payment_trade_state, pl.total AS payment_total, pl.service_fee AS payment_service_fee, pl.payer_openid AS payment_payer_openid, pl.success_time AS payment_success_time, ri.refund_number, ri.refund_id, ri.refund AS refund_amount, ri.refund_status, ri.reason AS refund_reason, ri.create_time AS refund_create_time FROM tb_orders o LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON o.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ap ON o.id = ap.order_id AND ap.role = 'PICKUP' LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ar ON o.id = ar.order_id AND ar.role = 'RECEIVE' LEFT JOIN tb_take_orders tk ON o.id = tk.order_id AND tk.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_payment_log pl ON o.order_number = pl.order_number
WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
